$sources: ACI 318-19 Sec 8.4.1.5 (column strip), 8.5.4 (openings in slab systems), 22.6.4.3 (openings near a column or concentrated load) and 11.7.5.1 (bars around openings in walls)
source: ACI 318-19: the openings and sleeves MEP cuts through beams, slabs and walls. The slab strip shares are slabMethods.openings, the wall layers concrete.walls.

sources.columnStripShare: ACI 318-19 Sec 8.4.1.5: the column strip extends on each side of the column centreline 0.25 l2 or 0.25 l1, whichever is less
sources.punchingDistance: ACI 318-19 Sec 22.6.4.3: openings in a column strip or closer than 4h to the periphery of a column, concentrated load or reaction area reduce the critical section
sources.trimBar: ACI 318-19 Sec 11.7.5.1: around window, door and similar openings at least two No. 5 bars (16 mm) in walls with two layers and one No. 5 bar in walls with one layer
sources.clauses: As the checks cite them (short form)
